preconditions.description: The number of lamps n must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n - 1 and all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: The list of main lamp indices must have n - 1 elements, each between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (1 <= k <= n and len(wires) == n - 1)
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to restore the scheme, output -1; otherwise, output a valid lamp index k and n - 1 wires.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in wires)
postconditions.description: Each wire must connect two distinct lamps with indices between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(any(a_i == main for main in [x, y]) for a_i, (x, y) in zip(a, wires))
postconditions.description: The main lamp indices must match the indices of the main lamps in the output wires.
